title: Cyclotomic Finite-Adelic PGF
pgf_formula: G_S(t) = Product_{p in S} (p - 2 + t)/(p - t)
euler_factor_formula: E_S(s) = Product_{p in S} (p - 2 + p^{-s})/(p - p^{-s})
theorem_summary: For every finite set S of split primes p congruent to 1 mod 3, the total cyclotomic valuation packet T_S has exact PGF equal to the product of the local factors (p-2+t)/(p-t), finite Euler factor equal to the product of the local Euler factors, and equal mean and variance Sum 2/(p-1).
